review.basis: Existing reviewed electric-boiler workbook; same inventory previously built by the native pilot, now prepared as mapping-declared inventory data.
limitations: Use the retained workbook's complete1MJelectric-boiler service and exact0.2805836139169472kWhdraw, on native Swiss medium-voltage electricity. The stated99%efficiency defines the source quantity; no extraefficiency factor is applied to its LCI. Native electricity, geography and vintage remain explicit proxies.

The retained workbook omits infrastructure because it has no process-material inventory. Preserve that limitation; do not invent a plant, lifetime, capacity, heat credit or extra loss. IAMfinal-electricity converts to delivered heat using the actual electricity draw*3.6MJ/kWh; heat-output secondary roles use factor1. No LCIAequivalence or impactcompleteness is claimed.
